home.headline:
Stack your own tingles✦
block by block

home.step2Body: Snap your blocks together from left to right. Use the layer to put rain underneath.
home.step3Body: Choose 30 minutes to 8 hours and the seamless track repeats for that long.

s1.title: Add blocks
s1.body: Add blocks with triggers you love (tapping, crinkles, whispers…) from the Block Shop. Free ones instantly, paid ones with a 30-second preview.

s2.title: Click them together
s2.body: In Build a combo, tap your blocks to chain them. Drag to reorder, and use the layer to overlap two sounds.

s3.title: How long?
s3.body: Choose 30 minutes to 8 hours and save — we build a seamless track that repeats for that long.

s4.title: Listen
s4.body: Your combos are at the top of the app's home screen. Save other people's combos you like from Combos in one tap.

guide.title: What are tingles?
guide.lead: It's the tingly, fizzy feeling on your scalp or neck when you listen to ASMR. Everyone's triggers are different, so picking and stacking only the sounds you love works best. ASMR Block turns each sound into a block — click them together and you get ASMR that fits you.

rec.title: Recording guide
rec.lead: All you need is a phone. A quiet spot, a hand's width away, one clear trigger. Get these right and you'll have a block people love to hear.
rec.dontsNote: Please upload only sounds you recorded yourself. These are sent back in review, and can be taken down later if reported.
rec.endTitle: Recorded something? Turn it into a block
rec.endBody: Long recordings are fine — pick the best part from the waveform when you upload.
rec.readyMsg: Great — start recording. Stay quiet for the first 5 seconds!
rec.linkTitle: New to recording? Read the guide
rec.linkBody: Quiet spot · a hand's width away · 5 quiet seconds at each end — how to record a great block on your phone

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.lead: How to delete your ASMR Block account and data. You can delete it yourself in the app or on the web, or ask us by email if you can't log in.
deleteAccount.stepApp: App: My account (top right) → "Delete account" at the bottom
deleteAccount.stepWeb: Web: log in → My account → "Delete account" at the bottom
deleteAccount.stepMail: Can't log in? Email {{email}} from the address you signed up with, titled "Account deletion request". We'll delete it within 7 days and reply.
deleteAccount.deleted1: The combos you made and your sleep log
deleteAccount.deleted2: Login sessions (you're logged out on every device)
deleteAccount.deleted3: Your email and nickname (changed so no one can tell who you were)
deleteAccount.kept1: Play history and collected blocks stay only as anonymous statistics.
deleteAccount.kept2: Blocks you uploaded may stay under "Deleted user" if someone already collected them. Email us if you want them removed.
deleteAccount.kept3: Server backups are deleted automatically after 14 days.
deleteAccount.more: See the Privacy Policy for details.
